newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Caldera to reshuffle cabinet Friday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Caldera to reshuffle cabinet Friday.

text.p: Venezuela's President Rafael Caldera will swear in Friday new ministers of justice, health and urban development, a government minister said Wednesday.
Health Minister Pedro Rincon Gutierrez said he was leaving his post to become Venezuela's ambassador to Peru.
He added that replacements for Justice Minister Henrique Meier and Urban Development Minister Francisco Gonzalez would also be announced Friday.
A presidential palace source added that no ministers in economic posts would be removed in these changes.
